title: Repeat-trial check is bypassed when the second trial event has no membership id
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: uid qa_tri_11: trial on mem_11a, then deactivated (expired)
Send membership.activated with status trialing and NO data.id / membership_id (user.id + product.id only)
expected: Second trial must not unlock; a user who already had a trial should be treated as a repeat whatever the payload shape.
actual: Response status trialing, /slate /edges /game /api/slate all 200. isRepeatTrial requires next.membership_id to be truthy, so a missing id disables the whole rule (fail-open). Also payment.succeeded on the new row is the only thing that should unlock.
